ops.title: Codex complete stage checkpoint and installer semantics
ops.body:
REPLY_FILE: /tmp/codex-port-stage.txt

CHECKPOINT — active staging dispatch, not rollout acceptance.
Task task_2e60214a6efe; dispatch ctx_8d3275b6debb.
Approved plan 486d766 in captain-hook/galeocerdo.
No live installs, cache edits, app restarts, commits, publication, or main-monorepo writes.

Completed evidence
- Complete structural native stage: /Users/yasyf/Code/codex-port-staging/speculative-2.
- 28 native packages: 27 enabled applicable identities plus repo-summaries; excludes only the Claude rust-analyzer LSP declaration.
- stage-evidence.json has assembly argv, source repo/head/status/diff hashes, untracked source hashes, 981 staged file hashes, executable file types, artifact hashes, and symlink targets.
- All 10 explicit artifact overrides are actual Mach-O arm64 executables. /tmp/codex-port-stage-installed-artifacts.json proves every native installed copy matches its candidate SHA256 and is not a symlink.
- Only retained binary symlinks are Captain Hook bin/capt-hook and bin/hook, whose app-version-dependent signed-helper/bootstrap contract is a remaining rollout gate; do not claim all launchers are ready.
- Actual isolated Codex ingestion: 28/28 installs succeeded, 66 skills listed with no skill errors, 20 native hooks listed. Evidence /tmp/codex-port-stage-probe-2/{installation.json,observations.json,protocol.jsonl,app-server.stderr}.
- These are ingestion checks, not behavioral acceptance. Hook trust remains untrusted. The old stage MCP commands fail substitution, and the ccn probe cwd lacked a git repo; owner reproduced ccn initialization successfully in a fresh temporary git cwd. Datadog returns401 without authentication.
- Claude source stage /Users/yasyf/Code/codex-port-staging/claude-speculative-2 has 24 selected identities in 11 full original catalogs. Preserves disabled extra cli-demo. Unchanged official/revdiff/gvzdv/cc-transcript registrations remain in place, including rust-analyzer; no narrow replacement of the 295-entry official catalog.
- Claude stage-only versions are original-version+codex.1, with original_version and candidate_version in provenance.json; original source manifests are unchanged.
- All 24 Claude identities installed in isolated home, 36 CLI calls with zero failures: /tmp/codex-port-stage-claude-probe-2/results.json.
- Actual installer semantics: Codex plugin add recopies same-version local bytes. Claude plugin update retains same-version bytes, while local +codex.1 metadata is accepted and selects new bytes (cache directory normalizes + to -). Supported uninstall/install also refreshes same-version Claude bytes, but coordinator selected explicit local candidate versions. Evidence /tmp/codex-port-stage-version-probe-2/{results.json,replace-marketplace.json,claude/local-version.json,claude/reinstall.json}.
- Claude marketplace add accepts replacing an existing name with another local source; Codex refuses a changed source until marketplace remove. Do not infer one host's installer behavior from the other.
- cc-present and codex-ask rebuilt after shared API freeze, with go test -race ./... and go vet ./... passing. Artifacts under /Users/yasyf/Code/codex-port-staging/artifacts; logs /tmp/codex-port-stage-{present,codex}-build.log. Existing frontend output reused; no web sources edited.

Source changes made under explicit coordinator authorization
- cc-skills tools/codex_package.py: removed blanket ${CLAUDE_ substring rejection in prose. Kept frontmatter, manifest, resource closure and symlink containment validation.
- cc-skills tools/test_codex_package.py: documented-Claude-variable and native-first fallback cases. All11 package tests pass.
- captain-hook scripts/package-codex.py and tests/test_codex_packaging.py: generate native skill frontmatter from shared source, preserve bodies/resources and original source bytes, test native MCP args/cwd and host-specific authoring instructions.
- captain-hook captain_hook/.mcp.codex.json: bare capt-hook, explicit --host codex mcp, omitted cwd, matching native runtime probe contract.
- captain-hook captain_hook/skills/authoring-hooks/SKILL.md: shared host table chooses .capt-hook/hooks and capt-hook --host codex in Codex; retains Claude directory and validation command; neutral workflow paths; requires supported native events and trusted global dispatcher.
- Focused packaging test passes; slop-cop ran on generated four skills and changed authoring skill. Existing procedure prose findings are retained, not claimed clean. Source frontmatter remains Claude-compatible.
- Latest generated Captain Hook source: /Users/yasyf/Code/codex-port-staging/captain-hook-source-2/plugins/captain-hook. speculative-2 predates this final authoring/MCP refresh.

Reproducible staging recipes
/tmp/codex-port-stage-build.py --output ABSENT_DIRECTORY
/tmp/codex-port-stage-claude.py --output ABSENT_DIRECTORY
/tmp/codex-port-stage-ingest.py --stage ABS_STAGE --probe ABSENT_TEMP_PROBE
/tmp/codex-port-stage-claude-ingest-2.py
/tmp/codex-port-stage-versions.py
All recipes use actual source-owned tools/codex_package.py and explicit artifact overrides. Current mappings are checkpoint mappings, not final acceptance.

Final refresh gates
1. Source owners finish PATH-based ccx/ccn/review/cco MCP manifests, native Getaway path correction, remaining reviews, and artifact revisions.
2. Refresh Captain Hook package from source-2 (or newer), all source roots and exact owner artifacts into a fresh native/Claude stage.
3. Final transcript anticipated14.19.0+codex.4 and capt-hook12.51.0+codex.2; do not use earlier .3/.1 pins as final.
4. Run real native MCP calls in a git-initialized temporary project via isolated cc-codex broker, with controlled PATH to candidate executables and full binding. Recipe received from broker owner; implementation pending.
5. Verify source freeze and final binary/source hashes, preserve original catalogs and candidate versions, then write final install/backup/rollback commands.
6. Signed Captain Hook helper remains unavailable (zero valid signing identities observed by owner); no live installation or trust/restart can proceed until coordinator has matching signed assets. Authentication/GUI/model-backed workflow checks remain explicit limits.

Install map agreed in principle, not executed
- Current ccx/cc-notes/cc-review/cco/cc-present/codex-ask/cc-guides resolve /opt/homebrew/bin; ~/.local/bin comes earlier in this shell PATH and currently has none of those names.
- Coordinator accepted per-link backed-up ~/.local/bin candidate symlinks to immutable stage artifacts rather than modifying Homebrew cells.
- capt-hook already resolves ~/.local/bin/capt-hook and needs exact matching candidate environment plus signed app; handle through its owner-supported artifact.Store/package-install contract.
- Broker-launched and isolated desktop PATH resolution must be proven, not inferred from this shell.

Continuation
Coordinator explicitly requested this dispatch continue past the approximate tool-call checkpoint through final gates. No nested workers were started. Final worker_done has not been sent.
